Powered with an Intel Core Ultra 9 24-Core processor and a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 graphics card, the Legion Pro 7i can handle PC games and AI workloads with ease. The 16" OLED display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate with G-SYNC support. The screen can handle HDR content, thanks to DisplayHDR True Black 500 and Dolby Vision support. It also includes 32GB of DDR5 RAM and two 1TB M.2 PCIe 4.0 SSDS for a total of 2TB storage, allowing you to multitask and store large games, photos, videos, and more. Stay connected with 2.5 GbE LAN or Wi-Fi 7. Windows 11 Home is the installed operating system. Intel Core i9 Performance The system houses an Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor. Its 24 cores are made up of 8 performance cores and 16 efficiency cores. The performance cores handle CPU-intensive workloads while the efficiency cores take care of background tasks. The performance cores feature a base speed of 2.7 GHz and can be boosted to 5.4 GHz. NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50-Series Graphics The dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 laptop graphics card in this laptop delivers the performance you need for high frame rates and high-res visuals for the latest games. Utilize real-time raytracing and DLSS 4 to make sure you get the most out of your gameplay. With NVIDIA Advanced Optimus, the laptop can intelligently switch between battery-saving and high-performance modes. 16" OLED Display The 16" display features a 2560 x 1600 resolution and a 240 Hz refresh rate, as well as G-SYNC support, so you can enjoy a smooth gaming experience. The OLED panel delivers deep black levels and vibrant colors. With Dolby Vision and DisplayHDR True Black 500 support, enjoy HDR content right on your Legion Pro 7i. Stay Connected for Online Play Whether you're playing with friends or competing against players from all around the world, the Legion Pro 7i can keep you connected. Use the 2.5 GbE RJ45 jack for a reliable connection. Playing while on the go? You can utilize Intel Killer Wi-Fi 7. Bluetooth 5.4 ensures you can wirelessly connect to compatible devices, such as a wireless mouse or gaming controller. Windows 11 Home Microsoft simplified the design and user experience with Windows 11. It has a modern, clean design with a new Start Menu position. Snap Layouts, Groups, and Desktops allow you to multitask with ease. Microsoft has also integrated some of their apps, such as Microsoft Teams. The redesigned Microsoft Store makes it easier to look for supported apps.
